title: Training fellowship application
heading: Apply to train with Dr Wakil.
intro: Cohorts are small and every application is reviewed personally by Dr Wakil. Tell us where you practise and what you intend to add to it.
note: Open to registered medical professionals. Your details stay with the training team and are never shared.

success.heading: Thank you — application received.
success.text: The training team will be in touch about the next cohort, its dates and what to prepare.

error.heading: That did not send.
error.text: Please try again, or email the clinic directly and we will take your application that way.

fields.help: GMC, or the equivalent body in your country.
